product.name: Monoprice DisplayPort 1.2a to 4K HDMI Single Link DVI and VGA Passive Adapter Black
product.description: Monoprice™DisplayPort 1.2a to 4K HDMI, Single Link DVI, and VGA Passive Adapter (Male to Female), BlackConnect a Desktop or Laptop with DisplayPort® to a 4K HDMI®, Single Link DVI™, or VGA MonitorConnect your DisplayPort®‑equipped PC to a 4K HDMI®, Single‑Link DVI™, or VGA video display with the Monoprice™ DisplayPort 1.2a to 4K HDMI, Single‑Link DVI, and VGA Passive Adapter! This adapter allows you to connect an HDMI, DVI, or VGA display to a DisplayPort video output. It conforms to the DisplayPort 1.2a standard and supports HDMI resolutions up to 4K (3840 x 2160) @30Hz, Dual‑Link DVI resolutions up to 2560 x 1600 @60Hz, and VGA resolutions up to 1920 x 1080 @60Hz. Being a passive adapter, it is NOT compatible with the AMD® Eyefinity and nVidia® Surround™ multidisplay modes. Note that only one of the three video outputs can be used at any given time.This unidirectional adapter connects a PC or laptop with DisplayPort to a 4K HDMI, Single‑Link DVI, or VGA monitor, display, or projector, but it does not function in reverse (cannot convert HDMI, DVI or VGA to DisplayPort). It features a true 6" cable length with polycarbonate connector housings. The VGA and DVI end panels contain screw holes for secure attachment.Conforms to DisplayPort® 1.2a standardSupports HDMI resolutions up to 3840 x 2160 @30HzSupports Single‑Link DVI resolutions up to 2560 x 1600 @60HzSupports VGA resolutions up to 1920 x 1080 @60HzPlug and Play installationGold‑plated connectors improve signal performanceDisplayPort connector features a locking design with push‑button release for a secure connection COMPATIBLE WITH LEGACY DISPLAYSThe DisplayPort 1.2a to 4K HDMI, Single‑Link DVI, and VGA Passive Adapter connects a desktop or laptop with a DisplayPort (DP, DisplayPort++, or DP++) to a monitor, projector, or HDTV with an HDMI, DVI, or VGA input. PACKAGE CONTENTS• 1x DisplayPort 1.2a to 4K HDMI, Single‑Link DVI, and VGA Passive Adapter • 1x User Manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
